is a single row block; N=80 splits into 5 column blocks and K=32 into 2 K-steps of 16. Scratchpad rows 0-15 hold the current A K-tile and rows 16-31 the current B tile. Phase 1 loads A cols 0-15 once and computes all 5 N-blocks in overwrite mode (out_addr bit30=0, acc rows 0-15); phase 2 reloads A cols 16-31 and computes all 5 N-blocks in accumulate mode (bit30=1) onto the same accumulator rows, giving reduction in increasing K order. Every A and B element is DMA'd exactly once: 2 A tiles + 10 B tiles = 12 mvins = 3072 input bytes, which is the information-theoretic minimum. All computes use accumulated=false with preload-staged B tiles (the latched-B path is never needed since M has only one tile), bd_spad_addr is always GARBAGE_ADDR per the schema, and out_addr always sets bit31 (accumulator) and bit29 (full C width). Five mvouts store the finished 16x16 blocks at C element offsets n*16 with store stride 320 bytes (80 int32 per C row), followed by a final fence."}
